answer: Identity cost is tied to a physical vertex. Each miner holds a quartz oscillator whose drift is measured against a public beacon for 30 minutes; the falcon handshake signs the challenge with that measured drift. Two identities sharing one crystal emit the same curve, so they are merged into one payout slot. Drift is quantised to 0.3 ppm and re-measured every epoch, so 1000 clones need 1000 distinct oscillators: at 12 USD each the floor is 12000 USD, against roughly 30 USD of reward per epoch, and the handshake must be re-signed live.
